description: This file implements an OAuth2 token handler class 'Oauth2Handler' responsible for validating OAuth2 tokens via introspection or token info endpoints. It includes methods to prepare requests, extract user data, and perform asynchronous token validation requests.

classes.name: Oauth2Handler
classes.description: A class that handles OAuth2 token validation, supporting both introspection and token info endpoints.

methods.name: bool _is_introspection_endpoint( token_info_endpoint: str, oauth_client_id: Optional[str], oauth_client_secret: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Determines if the OAuth2 endpoint URL is an introspection endpoint requiring POST.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,str],Dict[str,str]] _prepare_introspection_request( token: str, oauth_client_id: Optional[str], oauth_client_secret: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Prepares headers and data for OAuth2 introspection request, including client credentials if available.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _prepare_token_info_request(token: str)
methods.description: Prepares headers for token info endpoint requests.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str],Optional[str]] _extract_user_info( response_data: Dict, user_id_field_name: str, user_role_field_name: str, user_team_id_field_name: str, )
methods.description: Extracts user ID, role, and team ID from OAuth2 endpoint response data.

methods.name: UserAPIKeyAuth check_oauth2_token(token: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously validates an OAuth2 token by contacting the appropriate endpoint and returns user authentication info.

ctags.name: _extract_user_info
ctags.signature: ( response_data: Dict, user_id_field_name: str, user_role_field_name: str, user_team_id_field_name: str, )

ctags.name: _is_introspection_endpoint
ctags.signature: ( token_info_endpoint: str, oauth_client_id: Optional[str], oauth_client_secret: Optional[str], )

ctags.name: _prepare_introspection_request
ctags.signature: ( token: str, oauth_client_id: Optional[str], oauth_client_secret: Optional[str], )
